identity.title: [v0.92.1][C-SDLC] Fail closed on stale owner binaries before primary-checkout mutation

values.goal: Prevent stale or incomplete installed C-SDLC owner generations from mutating repository state, while independently preserving the primary-checkout bootstrap prohibition.
values.required_outcome: Every installed mutating C-SDLC v2 owner proves complete current owner-source provenance before mutation; rejected invocations leave the checkout unchanged; current bootstrap succeeds only in an allowed isolated FastWork checkout.
declared_scope: csdlc-v2 source, owner binaries, installer, and focused tests
C-SDLC installation and primary-checkout policy documentation
authority_boundary: Current source authority includes the primary-checkout guard merged by #548
Freshness is bound to the declared C-SDLC owner-source set, not unrelated repository HEAD changes
Existing primary-checkout residue belongs to other sessions unless separately proven
operator_constraints: Never create or edit issue artifacts in the primary checkout
Use only the isolated FastWork issue worktree
Do not delete or rewrite pre-existing residue
Do not expose token paths, credentials, or machine-local paths
Do not reintroduce v1 lifecycle wrappers
